Name: Nyapu's Style - Old Wizard for RRRR In-Game Sprite Patch
Author: NeverNotNor
Description:
[left]This mod is a replacer, so you will replace the existing sprites in Jello's Vanillia-ish RRRR mod with the sprites in this one. [/left]
[left]These sprites are intended to match with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42238]Jupm's Nyapu's Style - Old Wizard for RRRR[/url] mod. I highly recommend downloading those portraits alongside this mod for consistency. [/left]

I did not fully test these in-game, so if you see any issues, please let me know! 

How to install: Replace the "Characters" folder of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284]Jello's Vanilla-ish RRRR Wizard[/url] mod with the folder from this mod. 
There is an optional download that tweaks some of Jupm's portraits to fix some mirroring issues where the outfit in the portrait was flipped from the one in-world. Likewise, you would have to replace the files in the "Portraits" folder with the files in the optional download after downloading Jupm's portraits. 

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Jupm?gameId=1303]Jupm[/url] for the awesome portraits and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Jellonip?gameId=1303]Jellonip[color=#ffffff] for the awesome mod![/color][/url]

Downloads.Description: Extract folder into Assets/Characters in Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard folder. Replace all when prompted.

Optional replacers for Jupm's portraits that mirrors the base outfit and spring outfit to match the way it appears in-world. Extract into Portraits folder of Jello's Vanilla-ish Wizard AFTER installing Jupm's portraits.
